page_title_index: Hatopi Dex | Heartopia Fish, Bug & Bird Search Tool
meta_description: Unofficial Heartopia dex tool to search fish, bugs, and birds by location, weather, and time. See what's available right now. Sell price display included.
meta_description_foods: Full list of Heartopia recipes. Check ingredients, ingredient cost, sell price, and profit.
meta_description_garden: Heartopia crop and flower dex. Growth time, seed price, crossbreeding list, and notification support.
meta_description_pet: Heartopia pet food tracker. Keep track of what you've fed your dogs and cats.
meta_description_codes: List of active Heartopia gift codes. Check rewards and expiration dates.
meta_description_events: List of ongoing and upcoming Heartopia events and gacha info.
meta_description_faq: Frequently asked questions, requests, and bug fix status for Hatopi Encyclopedia.
page_header_subtitle: Displays creatures based on Heartopia's current weather and time
codes_page_subtitle: Tap a code to copy it
faq_page_subtitle: Frequently asked questions, requests, and bug fix status
garden_breeding_note: Crossbreeding happens every day at 6 AM. Place two of the same color next to each other to get a higher-rarity seed.
garden_notif_desc:
Normal: background notification at harvest time
Weeding: notifications at 3 weeding points plus harvest
garden_notif_permission_text: Notification permission is required to receive background notifications
garden_notif_blocked_text:
Notifications are blocked.
Please allow notifications for this site in your device/browser settings, then press the button below.
garden_toast_still_blocked: Still blocked. Please check your settings
garden_help_tabs_body: Use the "Crops" and "Flowers" tabs at the top to switch views. You can see growth time, seed price, and sell price for each.
garden_help_detail_body: Tap a card to see the sell price for each rarity (1–5 stars). For flowers, you'll also see the list of colors you can breed.
garden_help_check_body: Use the circle button in the top-right of a card to track completion, and the one in the bottom-right (shown only where applicable) to track Master certification.
garden_help_breeding_body: The flower detail screen shows the colors that flower can produce and example breeding combinations. Breeding happens every day at 6:00. Planting 2 flowers of the same color next to each other produces a seed one rarity tier higher. Combination examples only show colors that flower can actually produce.
garden_help_notif_body:
You can register notifications from a crop's detail screen.
Normal Mode: one notification at harvest time
Weeding Mode: 3 weeding alerts plus a harvest notification
Crops with notifications registered show a bell icon, and a timer and progress bar appear on the card.
garden_help_notice_body:
Harvest notifications only work if the site is added to your home screen and notification permission is granted.
Notifications may be off by up to about 1 minute. In Weeding Mode, the 1st and 2nd alerts fire around each third of the growth time, and the 3rd fires 1–2 minutes before harvest.
If issues come up, this feature may be paused without notice. Thank you for your understanding.

help_search_body: Search by creature name or location.
help_type_body: Switch between Fish, Bugs, and Birds, plus the seasonal Sand Sculpture, Snow Sculpture, and Shell categories.
help_mode_body:
· All currently appearing
· Current weather only
· Not appearing now
help_sort_body: Sort by encyclopedia order, level, incomplete first, or uncertified first.
help_server_body: Use the server selector at the top to change the displayed time. Appearance is always calculated in Japan time (JST); only the displayed time is converted to the selected server's time zone.
help_spot_body: Shows today's spawn location for both Firefly Stones and Oak Trees. Use the calendar button to check the schedule for the next few days.
help_tasks_body: See today's weather forecast, the time until the next scheduled quest, a checklist of items that reset daily, and events or codes that are ending soon — all in one place.
help_star_body:
Tap the ○ button (top-right of card) to check.
Multi-select → bulk check is also available.
help_auth_body:
Tap the ○ button (bottom-right of card) to check.
Multi-select → bulk check is also available.
help_multi_body_1: The multi-select feature has a few steps — here's how it works:
help_multi_body_2: 1. Press Multi-select to enter multi-select mode.
help_multi_body_3: 2. Tap all the creatures you want to check.
help_multi_body_4: 3. When done tapping, press the Star-5 or Master bulk check button.
help_multi_body_5: 4. After bulk checking, press Multi-select again to exit.
help_multi_body_6: Note: Star-5 and Master cannot be checked at the same time.
help_meteor_body: Meteor showers are treated as sunny weather.
help_minimize_body: Collapse the top panel using the minimize button.
help_share_body:
Press the share button to share.
Generates a simple image of your completion status.
help_sync_body: Use the button at the top to export or import your data (completion status, settings, and more) as a file. Handy as a backup when switching devices or browsers.
help_theme_body: Use the button at the top to toggle dark mode. Supported languages: Japanese / English / 한국어 / ไทย / 简体中文 / 繁體中文.
help_contact_body:
You can contact us at the bottom of the page.
Completely anonymous submissions are available.
help_contact_note: (A Q&A page for answers is planned.)
help_notice_body:
This site saves your state when you close it.
Your previous state will be restored when you reopen it.
privacy_body: All data on this site is managed within your browser (LocalStorage) only and is never sent externally.
contact_form_label: Bug reports, feature requests, and feedback welcome
disclaimer: ※ This is an unofficial tool created by an individual. It is not affiliated with the official game.
food_calc_no_target: No recipes currently have a master certification target set.
food_calc_no_materials: This recipe has no materials to calculate.
daily_tasks_video_meteor: Star Meteor fragments can be collected now
daily_tasks_video_pink_bubble: This week's Pink Bubble is here (until tomorrow)
daily_tasks_empty: No information to show right now
weekly_shop_hint: Purchase limits reset every Saturday at 6:00 AM (Japan time). Check that you haven't missed anything
data_sync_body: This site's data (completion status, master certifications, the recipe calculator, garden notification settings, pets, gift code claim status, today's checklist checkboxes, etc.) is stored only in your device's browser. If you want to move it to another device or back it up before clearing your browser data, you can export/import it below.
data_sync_note: Importing will overwrite your current data. Notification settings (fcmToken) are device-specific and won't carry over.
data_sync_confirm_overwrite: Overwrite your current data with this backup?
data_sync_invalid_format: This doesn't look like a valid backup file.

shop_page_subtitle: Check off items you've already purchased

meta_description_art: A browser-based pixel art tool for creating and saving Heartopia design layouts.
art_page_subtitle: Create and save pixel art designs right in your browser
art_tutorial_hint: You can check the how-to guide and replay the tutorial anytime from the "?" in the top right.
art_coming_soon: Some features are in trial release and will keep improving in future updates.
art_offline_banner_text: No login needed — your data stays on this device only. Works even with a weak connection.
art_confirm_unlock: Unlock this design? Be careful not to overwrite it by accident.
meta_description_art_convert: Convert an image into Heartopia pixel art right in your browser.
art_convert_page_subtitle: Upload an image and convert it into pixel art
art_crop_hint: Drag to reposition, use the slider to zoom in or out of the crop area
art_step_size_hint: Choosing the size first means you won't need to redo the position adjustment later
art_step_colors_hint: More colors stay closer to the original, but take longer to place in-game. Around 16 colors is a good starting point
art_invalid_image: Unsupported file type (JPG, PNG, or WebP only)
art_overwrite_draft_confirm: You have a draft in progress. Overwrite it with this conversion result?
art_fit_hint: Crop/Fill fill the whole canvas, Fit shows the full image with padding around it
art_step_preset_hint: Standard works well for photos, Smooth for illustrations, and Crisp for line art or icons
art_step_noise_hint: Adjust this if a photo looks grainy. It's best to do this before reducing the color count
art_share_code_hint: No account needed — share your design as text, or use it as a backup before switching devices
art_share_code_modal_hint: Paste the code or URL below into Discord, notes, etc. to share it. Paste it back in "Import Code" anytime to restore it.
art_share_qr_too_long: Too long for a QR code — please copy the code or URL instead
art_share_code_import_hint: Paste a shared code below. This will overwrite your current design, so save it first if needed.
art_share_import_confirm_overwrite: This will replace your current design with the shared one. Continue?
art_share_code_invalid: Failed to read the share code
art_share_code_checksum: Share code looks incorrect (it may have been mistyped or cut off)
art_share_code_unsupported_version: This share code's version isn't supported
art_save_prompt: Enter a name for this design
art_mydesigns_storage_note: Saved designs stay only in this device's browser (no account needed). Before switching devices, back them up with a Share Code.
art_confirm_new_canvas: Create a new canvas without saving the current one?
art_ssi_upload_hint: Choose an in-game screenshot showing the outfit you're wearing
art_ssi_error_unsupported_file: This image format isn't supported. Please choose a screenshot (JPEG/PNG, etc.)
art_ssi_error_load_failed: Couldn't load this image. Please try a different one
art_ssi_error_too_small: This image is too small. Please try a larger screenshot
art_ssi_error_processing: This device failed to process the image. Please try a different image or device
art_ssi_error_extract_failed: Couldn't extract the design. Try selecting the region again, or use a different image
art_ssi_auto_detect_hint: We matched the guide lines visible in the screenshot to identify the canvas and its position automatically (accuracy improves when the guide lines are clearly visible)
art_ssi_low_confidence: Couldn't auto-detect the canvas. Please choose one from the list
art_ssi_adjust_hint: If the detected area looks off, drag the box to move it or drag the corners to resize it
art_ssi_settings_hint: You can adjust the color count and other settings before importing
meta_description_music: Create, save, and practice numbered musical notation (jianpu) for Heartopia's instruments, right in your browser.
music_page_subtitle: Create and save numbered notation, and practice playing it
music_coming_soon: This feature is currently under development. It will become available in a future update.
music_duration_hint: The length selected above is used both for notes entered with the play buttons and for rests added with "Add rest"
music_loop_select_hint: Tap a note in the score to choose the start
music_loop_select_hint_end: Tap a note in the score to choose the end
music_calib_hint: Drag to move, pinch with two fingers to resize. This applies to every instrument and layout on this device
music_calib_hint_once: If the buttons look off, tap here to match them to your game screen
music_practice_hint: Notes sound only while you hold the button. Even while stopped, pressing the correct next note will advance the highlight.
music_follow_hint: Place this next to the actual game screen to check the next note while you play. Muting the sound effect is recommended.
music_rotate_hint: Turn your device sideways to see the performance buttons at the same size as in-game
music_confirm_new: Discard the current score and start a new one?
music_new_type_hint: You can convert a free-timing score to a bar-based one later (one-way only).
music_new_type_bar_body: Note lengths are managed in fixed units (e.g. quarter notes) based on tempo and time signature
music_new_type_free_body: Records the actual length of each note without being tied to a tempo. Good for auto-generating from MIDI, audio, or video
music_freetiming_hint: This is a free-timing score. Changing the tempo scales the actual playback speed in practice/follow mode. Time signature is only used for the approximate bar-line display and doesn't affect playback timing
music_confirm_convert_to_bar: Convert this score to a bar-based score using the current tempo and time signature. Continue?
music_maxnotes_hint: Recommended: 2-4. If a detected chord has more notes than this, the melody (highest) and bass (lowest) notes are kept and the rest are automatically thinned out.
music_key_label_toggle: You can also play with a PC keyboard (show key labels)
music_record_hint: How long you hold the button becomes the note's length. Press multiple buttons at once to record a chord.
music_onboard_step1_hint: Pick the instrument you want to practice. You can change it anytime later
music_onboard_step2_hint: Choose a rough tempo and time signature. It's fine to leave the defaults if you're not sure
music_onboard_step3_hint: You can switch between the two anytime later
music_onboard_choice_record_body: How long you hold each button becomes the note's length
music_onboard_choice_manual_body: Pick a length, then press a button to add that note to the score
music_confirm_tempo_before_record: Tempo and time signature are still at their default values. Since note lengths during recording are calculated from the tempo, we recommend checking them first. Start recording anyway?
music_hum_hint: Record or upload humming to automatically convert it into a score (beta feature. Only the first use needs a connection to download the analysis model — your recorded audio itself is never sent anywhere)
music_hum_caution: Hum slowly and clearly, one note at a time, for the best results. Fast songs, chords, or audio with background music may not be recognized well. Only the first use needs a connection to download the analysis model — the audio you record or upload is analyzed entirely on this device, in your browser, and is never sent anywhere
music_hum_upload: Choose an audio or video file
music_hum_mic_error: Couldn't access the microphone. Check your browser settings, or upload an audio file instead
music_hum_no_notes: No notes were detected. Try humming a bit more clearly and slowly
music_hum_done_toast: Converted to a score. Notes with a gold outline were auto-detected — tap one to fix it
music_hum_analyze_error: Analysis failed. Try a different recording, or try again later
music_hum_review_banner: {n} auto-detected notes still need review. Tap one to check or fix it
music_melody_section_hint: Automatically convert humming, an audio file, or a video file into a score (beta feature. Only the first use needs a connection to download the analysis model — the audio/video data itself is never sent anywhere)
music_audio_caution: Supports audio with chords or multiple notes at once. Audio with a clear vocal or lead melody converts best. Detection may be less accurate when accompaniment, drums, or sound effects are mixed in strongly. Only the first use needs a connection to download the analysis model — the audio you upload is analyzed entirely on this device, in your browser, and is never sent anywhere (supports files up to 6 minutes; file size limit: 250MB). If you choose a MIDI file (.mid), it's converted directly from its pitch/timing data without using the analysis model (chords are preserved as-is)
music_video_caution: The audio track is extracted from the video and analyzed. Supports videos with chords or multiple notes at once. Videos with a clear vocal or lead melody convert best. Detection may be less accurate when accompaniment, drums, or sound effects are mixed in strongly. Only the first use needs a connection to download the analysis model — the video you upload is processed entirely on this device, in your browser, and is never sent anywhere (supports files up to 6 minutes; file size limit: 250MB)

music_midi_warn_empty_result: The conversion result has no notes. Try choosing a different track or instrument
music_midi_preview_apply_hint: Choosing "Apply to current score" overwrites the score you're editing now (this cannot be undone). Use "Save as new score" if you want to keep it
music_midi_export_empty: There are no notes to export
music_hum_model_load_error: Failed to load the analysis model. Check your connection and try again

music_melody_duration_too_short: This audio is too short (needs to be at least 3 seconds). Try a longer clip

music_melody_no_notes_file: Couldn't detect any notes. Try a different file
music_note_toolbar_hint: Play a note to replace the selected one with it
art_color_replace_banner: Pick a color from the palette to replace it with
art_color_replace_start_toast: Pick the replacement color from the palette
art_crop_mask_hint: The white lines show the actual shape. Line up your image with this area
art_3d_preview_hint: See a 3D look combining this part with your other saved parts
art_3d_preview_drag_hint: Drag to rotate, pinch to zoom
art_3d_preview_note: This is an experimental feature. It may look slightly different from the actual in-game appearance
art_3d_preview_load_error: Failed to load. Please try again with a better connection
art_mode_wizard_title: Choose how you'd like to work
art_mode_wizard_block_desc: Work through 10x10 blocks one at a time, focused and step by step
art_mode_wizard_normal_desc: See the whole canvas and paint in any order you like
music_confirm_open_discard: The score you're editing has unsaved changes. Discard them and open this one?
music_toast_save_failed: Save failed. Please check your available storage and try again
music_toast_name_too_long: Score name is too long (max {max} characters)

music_hum_mic_denied: Microphone access was denied. Allow microphone access for this site in your browser/OS settings, or upload an audio file instead

meta_description_build: A tool for Heartopia (Heartopia: Relaxing Farm Life) that converts an image into a building-material placement map to help with wall murals and pixel-art builds.
build_page_subtitle: Convert an image into a building-material placement map (mural mode)
build_notice: Only mural mode (2D) is available in this trial release. Voxel mode (3D) is planned for a future update.
build_size_hint: Set the width and height in cells (width up to 24, height up to 17 as a guide)
build_result_hint: Tap a cell to change its assigned material
build_new_image: Start over with a new image
build_help_1_body: Upload the image you want to turn into a mural.
build_help_2_body: Set the width and height in cells. The in-game plot (24 cells wide) and building height (17 cells) are a rough upper limit.
build_help_3_body: Drag to position and use the slider to zoom, then decide the crop area.
build_help_4_title: ④ Placement map and material list
build_help_4_body: The nearest support-pillar material is assigned automatically for each color. Tap a cell to choose a different material. The types and counts of materials needed are shown in the list.
build_help_5_body: Name your design and save it to recall it anytime from "Saved designs" below. You can also export/import it as JSON (useful for backups or moving to another device).
build_import_confirm: Add the imported designs? (existing designs will be kept)
